description: This is a unit test class for the RetrieveThingStrategy in a Java project, testing various scenarios of retrieving a 'thing' using the RetrieveThingStrategy class. It includes checks for immutability, handling of deviant IDs, context states, and correct retrieval responses.

classes.name: RetrieveThingStrategyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the RetrieveThingStrategy component, ensuring correct behavior in various retrieval scenarios and immutability.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test case by instantiating RetrieveThingStrategy.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that RetrieveThingStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: isNotDefinedForDeviantThingIds
methods.description: Checks that the strategy is not defined for deviant or invalid Thing IDs.

methods.name: isNotDefinedIfContextHasNoThing
methods.description: Verifies that the strategy is not defined if the context does not contain a Thing state.

methods.name: isDefinedIfContextHasThingAndThingIdsAreEqual
methods.description: Ensures that the strategy is defined when the context state matches the Thing ID in the command.

methods.name: retrieveThingFromContextIfCommandHasNoSnapshotRevisionAndNoSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Thing when no snapshot revision or selected fields are specified.

methods.name: retrieveThingFromContextIfCommandHasNoSnapshotRevisionButSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieval with specified selected fields.

methods.name: unhandledReturnsThingNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Ensures that when retrieval is unhandled, a ThingNotAccessibleException is thrown.
